summary: Sequential open/parse plus clamp-with-validation: first calls sub_51512C(a1, a2) and only if it returns a non-negative status calls BatchClampToMax(a1); if that also returns non-negative the function returns 0 (success), otherwise it propagates the failing status code. a1 is a float buffer, a2 an unsigned short parameter whose role is not established.

local_names.result: status code returned by sub_51512C and BatchClampToMax; non-negative means success

operations.description: Call sub_51512C(a1, a2) with the float buffer and unsigned short argument; store the returned status in result
Only proceed when result is >= 0 (sub_51512C succeeded)
Call BatchClampToMax(a1) to clamp the float buffer; store the returned status in result
When BatchClampToMax also returned >= 0, return success constant 0
Return the failing status code (from sub_51512C or BatchClampToMax) when either call returned negative

unresolved: Semantics of sub_51512C (candidate: file/stream open and parse into the float buffer) are outside this packet
Semantics of BatchClampToMax (clamping a batch of floats to a maximum) and what maximum it applies are outside this packet
Role of the unsigned short pointer a2 and the object owner are unknown; packet has no owner evidence
